titre: Exercices — Structures complexes : causatif, emphase, inversion
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Transforme en causatif : « A mechanic is repairing my brakes. → I ___ . »
corrige: Faire faire → have + objet + PP.
I am having my brakes repaired.
exercices.reponse: I am having my brakes repaired.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Je vais me faire couper les cheveux demain. »
corrige: Causatif have/get + objet + PP.
I'm going to have/get my hair cut tomorrow.
exercices.reponse: I'm going to have my hair cut tomorrow.

exercices.enonce: Explique la différence : « I cleaned my windows. » vs « I had my windows cleaned. »
corrige: La 1re : c'est moi qui ai nettoyé.
La 2nde : je les ai fait nettoyer par quelqu'un d'autre (causatif).
exercices.reponse: I cleaned = je l'ai fait moi-même ; I had my windows cleaned = je les ai fait nettoyer.

exercices.enonce: Mets « Sarah » en relief : « Sarah sent the email. → ___ »
corrige: Clivée It + be + élément + who.
It was Sarah who sent the email.
exercices.reponse: It was Sarah who sent the email.

exercices.enonce: Mets l'objet en relief avec What : « I need a break. → ___ »
corrige: Clivée What + sujet + verbe + be.
What I need is a break.
exercices.reponse: What I need is a break.

exercices.enonce: Renforce l'affirmation : « I like this idea (insistance). → ___ »
corrige: Emphase avec do + base verbale.
I do like this idea.

exercices.enonce: Réécris avec inversion : « I have never eaten such a good meal. → Never ___ »
corrige: Never en tête → inversion sujet/auxiliaire.
Never have I eaten such a good meal.
exercices.reponse: Never have I eaten such a good meal.

exercices.enonce: Réécris : « He didn't just apologise; he also paid for the damage. → Not only ___ »
corrige: Not only en tête → inversion, avec did car pas d'auxiliaire.
Not only did he apologise, but he also paid for the damage.
exercices.reponse: Not only did he apologise, but he also paid for the damage.

exercices.enonce: Réécris sans if : « If you had told me earlier, I would have come. »
corrige: Inversion du type 3 : Had + sujet + PP.
Had you told me earlier, I would have come.
exercices.reponse: Had you told me earlier, I would have come.

exercices.enonce: Traduis avec inversion et causatif : « À peine avais-je fait réparer ma voiture qu'elle est retombée en panne. »
corrige: « à peine ... que » → No sooner had I ... than / Hardly had I ... when.
« fait réparer » → causatif had my car repaired.
No sooner had I had my car repaired than it broke down again.
exercices.reponse: No sooner had I had my car repaired than it broke down again.
